name: link_prediction
author: 41c8e8e2
description: Predicts which pairs of currently unconnected nodes are most likely to become linked, using neighbourhood scores: adamic_adar (default), common_neighbors, jaccard, resource_allocation or preferential_attachment. Use it for questions like 'who should Alice connect with next?' or 'which links are probably missing?'. Give an optional node id to get suggestions only for that node; otherwise the best pairs graph-wide. Direction and weights are ignored (a pair counts as connected if an edge exists in either direction). Returns the top_k pairs as source/target nodes with a score.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'karate'.

method.description: Scoring method: adamic_adar, common_neighbors, jaccard, resource_allocation or preferential_attachment.

node.description: Optional node id: only suggest new links for this node. Use lookup_node to find an id from a name.

top_k.description: How many predicted links to return.
